activity_context.topic_title: Solving Systems of Equations Using Inverse Matrices

feedback.problem:
Solve the following system of linear equations by finding the inverse of the coefficient matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}z+2y+7x=1 \\ 3y-z=-2 \\ 4y-2z-3x=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We organize the system so that it’s in the correct order first:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}7x+2y+z=1 \\ 3y-z=-2 \\ -3x+4y-2z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

We wish to write this system in the form $Ax=b$, where $A$ is a $3\times 3$ matrix and $x$ and $b$ are $3\times 1$ column vectors. We can do this as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & -1 \\ -3 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, the solution to $Ax=b$ is given by $x={A}^{-1}b.$ So, we compute ${A}^{-1}$ as follows:

*Step 1:*

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}7 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & -1 \\ -3 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =7|\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}|-2|\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ -3 & -2\end{aligned}|+1|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =7(-6+4)-2(-3)+1(9) \\  & =-14+6+9 \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 2:*

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}3 & -1 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ -3 & -2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}7 & 1 \\ -3 & -2\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ -3 & 4\end{aligned}| \\ |\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}7 & 1 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}| & |\begin{aligned}7 & 2 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 & 9 \\ -8 & -11 & 34 \\ -5 & -7 & 21\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

*Step 3:*

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 & 9 \\ 8 & -11 & -34 \\ -5 & 7 & 21\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 4:*

$$
{C}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 8 & -5 \\ 3 & -11 & 7 \\ 9 & -34 & 21\text{ }\end{aligned}].
$$

*Step 5:*

$$
{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{det(A)}{C}^{T}=\frac{1}{1}[\begin{aligned}-2 & 8 & -5 \\ 3 & -11 & 7 \\ 9 & -34 & 21\text{ }\end{aligned}].
$$

Hence

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 8 & -5 \\ 3 & -11 & 7 \\ 9 & -34 & 21\text{ }\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-18 \\ 25 \\ 77\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Hence the solution is $x=-18,\,y=25,\,z=77.$
